EXAM 1
1. [LO 1.a] Which statement best describes expected loss?
A. The largest observed loss
B. The probability-weighted average loss
C. The loss after insurance
D. The variance of returns

2. [LO 1.a] A portfolio has a 20% chance of losing 10 and an 80% chance of losing 0. What is expected loss?
A. 0
B. 2
C. 8
D. 10

ANSWER KEY
1. B. Expected loss is the probability-weighted average loss.
2. B. Expected loss is 0.20 x 10 + 0.80 x 0 = 2.
